name: media-downloader-local
description: Local-only MediaDL — Next.js + Express + FastAPI, no Docker / Redis / MySQL / auth.

scripts.setup:py: python -m venv .venv && node scripts/py.mjs -m pip install --upgrade pip && node scripts/py.mjs -m pip install -r python-service/requirements.txt && node scripts/py.mjs -m playwright install chromium
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix telegram-bot install && npm run setup:py
scripts.dev:py: cross-env PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir python-service --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.start:py: cross-env PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir python-service --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n py,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm:start:py" "npm:start:api" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
